exam_name: Silver Hawk Sprint - AI Engineer L10
essay_prompt: Propose an AI-enabled modernization approach for a legacy application estate. Cover business case, functional process change, architecture, cloud, engineering execution, and optional code examples.
essay_response:
Business Case
Modernize legacy apps with AI to cut maintenance costs 40-60%, boost agility for new features, enhance security/compliance. ROI via faster time-to-market, reduced downtime; pilot one app to quantify.
Functional Process Change
Use AI for automated refactoring: analyze code for patterns, suggest microservices decomposition. Shift monolithic processes to event-driven, AI-optimized workflows (e.g., predictive maintenance via ML).
Architecture
Adopt microservices architecture with AI integration: API gateways, containerization. Embed GenAI for dynamic scaling, anomaly detection; use serverless for AI inference.
Cloud
Migrate to hybrid/multi-cloud (e.g., AWS/Azure): lift-and-shift initially, then refactor with AI tools like AWS SageMaker for ML models. Ensure data sovereignty, auto-scaling.
Engineering Execution
Agile phases: Assess legacy code with AI scanners; refactor using tools like GitHub Copilot; test with AI-generated cases; deploy via CI/CD. Train teams on AI ethics/security.
Code Examples
Python snippet for AI-assisted code analysis (using Hugging Face Transformers):
Pythonfrom transformers import pipeline

analyzer = pipeline("text-classification", model="distilbert-base-uncased")
result = analyzer("Legacy COBOL code: PRINT 'Hello'")  # Classify patterns
print(result)  # Output: [{'label': 'PATTERN_X', 'score': 0.95}]
Node.js example for AI-optimized API:
JavaScriptconst aiModel = require('some-ai-lib');
app.get('/legacy-endpoint', async (req, res) => {
  const prediction = await aiModel.predict(req.query);
  res.json({ optimized: prediction });
});

scenario_prompt: A field service team has inconsistent resolution times and weak knowledge reuse. Design an AI-enabled solution that improves operations while keeping controls and observability in place.
scenario_response:
Solution Overview
GenAI-powered mobile assistant + dynamic knowledge base for field technicians: real-time diagnostics, resolution guidance, auto-capture of solutions.
Business Value
Cuts inconsistent resolution times 30-60% via instant relevant suggestions; boosts knowledge reuse 2-3x through auto-generated, searchable case library from every job.
Governance
Role-based access; audit logs for every AI recommendation; human approval required for critical actions; compliance with data regs via anonymization.
Architecture
Integrate GenAI (LLM + RAG) with FSM/CRM; mobile app with offline edge inference; secure API layer; vector DB for knowledge retrieval.
Risk
Hallucination control: ground responses in verified historical cases + human feedback loop; bias monitoring; encryption; fallback to manual process.
Delivery Execution
MVP in 6-8 weeks: pilot 1 region/team; measure MTTR + reuse rate; iterate with technician input; train via short sessions; scale enterprise-wide post-proof.1.9sFast
